# dsh-telegram-channel-ru

> **Русский клон hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel
> с доработками.** Взята база `0.3.5` (коммит `7af6cef

`) и добавлено: полностью
> русский интерфейс, скрытие архивных сессий в меню выбора, наименование с

ессии на
> кнопке, чтение каталога через хост-сервисы DSH 0.2 (там, где оригинал ждал
> удалённый `a

piProxy`), и русская карточка бота. Репозиторий:
> <https://github.com/danilinao/dsh-telegram-channe

l-ru>. Что именно изменено и как
> синхронизироваться с оригиналом — в UPSTREAM.md.
>
> **Имя пакета

и имя репозитория — `dsh-telegram-channel-ru`** (суффикс `-ru`
> отделяет русское ответвление от ор

игинала в общем пространстве имён; на npm

Telegram-пульт для **DeepSeek Harness**: телефон подключается к уже идущей сессии
на компьютере и пр

одолжает её — **один диалог, две стороны**. Компьютер остаётся
источником истины: плагин не запускае

т второй агент и не дублирует контекст, а
[该节后续省略]
## Что умеет

- **Настройки в Web-интерфейсе: вкладка «Telegram» в «Настройках».** Токен,
список пользователей, до

ступ и формат сообщений — как у cost-meter и
plugin-market, без перезапуска `dsh` и без ручной правк

и YAML. Та же форма
открывается и с карточки плагина (**Plugins → dsh-telegram-channel-ru**).
Нескол

ько человек в белом списке, добавление по `@username` и по id.
[该节后续省略]
## Features

- **Attach to a live session.** `/sessions` walks workspace → session → attach.
After attaching, pla

in text (and images) go straight into that session.
- **Russian UI.** Every user-facing string — com

mands, Telegram command menu,
pickers, `/status`, `/compact`, notifications, errors — is Russian, an

d the bot
carries a Russian profile card (`setMyDescription` / `setMyShortDescription`).
- **Archive

d sessions hidden.** The picker only lists live sessions. Archived ids
are matched in both spellings

(`session-<uuid>` and `<uuid>`), the per-item
`archived` / `archivedAt` flags are honoured, and `ar

chivedSessionIds` from the
host is merged in. Workspaces left with nothing live disappear from the m

enu.
- **Session names on the buttons.** A button reads `N. <name> ▶/▷`, where the
name comes from t

he session title, else the first user message
(`titleInput.first.text`), else `workspace · date`. `▶

` means the session is
live in memory, `▷` means it is parked and will be resumed on attach. Cold
se

ssions are named through the host's projection API, cached by `updatedAt`.
- **Images, not just text

.** PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, with or without a caption; album
photos are merged into a single message. Ima

ges go through the host attachment
service, the same channel the web UI uses.
- **Reasoning and tool

calls, collapsed.** Each answer arrives after a
«🧠 Рассуждения» blockquote holding the model's thin

king, and every tool call
arrives with its full arguments; both are Telegram expandable quotes
(`<bl

ockquote expandable>`) that open with one tap. `/reasoning off` silences
the reasoning for one chat.

- **Not only text.** Photos (png/jpeg/webp/gif, captions and albums) and
text documents — `txt`, `m

d`, `json`, `yaml`, `csv`, code (`.gd`, `.ts`,
`.py`, …), up to 128 KB — arrive in the session as pr

ompt text next to the
caption. Binary files go through the web UI.
- **Two-way questions and approva

ls.** When the agent asks a multiple-choice
question or requests permission for a tool, you can answ

er from Telegram:
options arrive as **inline buttons**, alongside «✏️ Свой ответ» for free-form
[该节后

rom Telegram:
options arrive as **inline buttons**, alongside «✏️ Свой ответ» for free-form
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements

- A working DeepSeek Harness with the `web` profile (`dsh web`).
- Node.js as shipped with Harness.

- A Telegram bot token from @BotFather and your own
numeric user id from @userinfobot — the allowlis

t is
a hard gate: with it empty, the bot answers nobody.
- Outbound HTTPS to `api.telegram.org`. If

your network needs a proxy or a VPN,
set `HTTP(S)_PROXY` for the harness process or route it at the

OS level — the
plugin itself knows nothing about tunnels and just uses an ordinary HTTPS
client (wit

h environment proxy support).
- No Python, no extra services.
## How it works

1. The bot long-polls `getUpdates` and answers only users from the allowlist.
2. `/sessions` builds

a catalog of workspaces and sessions and remembers it against
your chat, so button callbacks stay co

nsistent even if the list is refreshed.
3. Attaching resolves the session: a live agent is used as-i

s, a cold session is
resumed through the host's `agents.resume`.
4. Messages are delivered through t

he host's session pipeline — the same one the
web UI uses — so streaming, tool calls, questions and

approvals reach the phone
while they happen.
5. Bindings survive restarts: the chat → session map is

persisted, and the plugin
logs how many bindings it restored.
Nothing leaves the machine except the Telegram Bot API traffic.
